entity_description: A complete HomeMaster external-world FactRecord about an object, device, room, place, service, account, or other non-user subject.
entity_instruction: When the input states a subject's predicate and value, ALWAYS create exactly one fact entity. Use a stable entity name in the form '<subject name>::<predicate>'. Preserve the stated value exactly. Do not turn user profile information into this entity.

static_property.name: Stable '<subject name>::<predicate>' identity for this fact
static_property.subject_type: One of object, device, room, place, service, account, or other

fact_value.desc: The complete self-contained fact in the form '<subject name> <predicate> <value>'. Preserve the value and all location or state details exactly.
fact_value.example: 相机电池 location 书房右侧第二层抽屉

entity_description: A reusable HomeMaster ProcedureRecord that was verified successfully in the environment.
entity_instruction: When the input describes a named workflow with an entry URL and ordered steps, ALWAYS create exactly one task_experience entity. Preserve the safe URL, ordered actions, targets, expectations, outputs, and success condition. Never invent input values or credentials.

static_property.name: Exact procedure name
static_property.entry_url: Safe absolute entry URL without credentials or session data

task_experience.desc: The complete reusable procedure as one self-contained ordered workflow, including its name, safe entry URL, steps, verification expectations, outputs, and final success condition.
task_experience.example: 流程 查询设备状态，入口 https://example.test/devices，步骤 1.open:{...}；2.extract:{...}

entity_description: MANDATORY: create exactly one episode entity for every input segment as the original input backup.
entity_instruction: Use a concise topic summary as the name. The description and input_messages are filled by the system.

static_property.detail: Detailed objective description of the input
static_property.input_messages: Raw input context; leave blank because the system fills it
